summary.notes: Only 3 of 6 clear cleanly on published numbers (enchilada casserole 538, jalapeno popper 535, basil turkey meatballs 499). The 475-cal floor at under 35 g carb is hostile to lean turkey; qualifying dishes get calories from heavy cream / cream cheese / cheese, not the meat. Selector should treat items 4-6 as margin-risk. Unmapped flags for the pricer lane: pork rinds, everything bagel seasoning, keto ketchup, sugar-free pickle juice.
